home.title: Home
home.welcome: Stoafi turns your salary and regular costs into a monthly plan. Start by telling it what comes in and what goes out.
home.overspent: Your monthly costs are above your income.
home.fundLow: Your emergency fund is below your target.

profile.title: Profile
profile.salariesHint: Regular monthly pay only. One-off money is not counted.
profile.expensesHint: Loans, installments, bills, subscriptions: anything that leaves your account every month.
profile.livingExpensesHint: Groceries and everyday spending as one monthly total.
profile.suggestedInflationCaption: Suggested from an approximate snapshot ({asOf}). Check current figures and edit if needed.
profile.emergencyFundReached: You already have your emergency fund target.
profile.emergencyFundOnTrack: At your current pace you reach the target in {month}.
profile.emergencyFundUnreachable: Your monthly surplus is not enough to reach the target yet.

plan.fillProfileFirst: Add your income and expenses first.

queue.fillProfileAndPlanFirst: Add your income and expenses first.
queue.name: Name
queue.empty: Nothing in the queue yet. Add what you want or need above.

time.unaffordableHint: These do not fit in the next 12 months with your current plan.

emptyState.title: Your queue is empty
emptyState.text: Add something you are thinking of buying. Waiting a little before deciding is the whole idea.

queuePreview.cardTimingTip: Buying after the statement day adds {days} extra float days; due {month}.
queuePreview.suggestedNone: This item is not affordable yet within the next 12 months.

guard.emergency-fund-floor: This purchase would drop your emergency fund below its target.
guard.installment-cap: Your monthly installments would go above the cap you set.
guard.wants-limit: This purchase would push your wants above their limit for the month.
guard.unknown: This purchase breaks one of your safety rules.

installments.title: Calculate with installments
installments.hint: Enter each offer's monthly payment as quoted by the bank or store.

cards.title: Cards
cards.labelRequired: Enter a name for the card.

empty.title: Add your first card
empty.text: Pick your bank to start. I will track statement and due days and your limit, and hint at the best day to buy.

form.bankHint: Colours are approximate and only give the card the feel of its bank.
form.label: Card name
form.parentHint: A supplementary card shares the limit of its main card.
form.parentRequired: Choose the main card this one belongs to.
form.limitHint: Leave at 0 if you do not want to track it.
form.currentDebtHint: Optional. Remaining installments bought through the queue are added automatically.
form.last4Hint: Optional. Never enter the full number.
form.last4Invalid: Enter exactly four digits, or leave it empty.

detail.limitBar: Share of the limit in use
detail.sharedNote: All cards of this group draw from one limit.
detail.noLimit: Add a limit to see how much is left.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {name}?
deleteDialog.plain: This removes the card from the app. Your bank account is not touched.
deleteDialog.withExtras: This card has supplementary cards. Delete them too, or keep them as separate main cards.
deleteDialog.limitsHint: A main card needs its own limit. Enter one for each card you keep.

minimumPayment.title: Minimum-payment trap calculator
minimumPayment.neverPaysOff: This debt never pays off: the minimum payment is smaller than the interest.

health.title: Health
health.fillProfileFirst: Add your income and expenses first.

savingsRate.label: What is the savings rate?
savingsRate.text: The share of your income you put into savings and investing each month.

emergencyFundMonths.label: What are emergency fund months?
emergencyFundMonths.text: How many months of your needs your savings would cover. Most guides suggest 3 to 6 months.

installmentRatio.label: What is the installment ratio?
installmentRatio.text: The share of your income that goes to installment payments each month. Lower means more room to breathe.

runway.label: What is the runway?
runway.text: How many months you could pay your needs and installments from savings if your income stopped.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.emptyTitle: Your shopping decisions will gather here
decisions.emptyText: When you buy, postpone or skip something from your queue it is recorded here, with the money you saved turned into hours of your life. Waiting 30 days before a want is the habit this page rewards.

stats.savedWorkDays: About {days} work days of your time
stats.savedCount: {count, plural, one {# purchase skipped} other {# purchases skipped}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.importConfirmTitle: Replace your data with this backup?
settings.importConfirmText: Importing replaces everything stored in this app. Export a backup first if you are not sure.

installmentExpenses.title: Installments from purchases
installmentExpenses.hint: Added automatically when you buy something from the queue in installments.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.intro: Every recommendation in Stoafi comes from a book or an investor. These cards explain the idea in our own words, how the app uses it, who it suits and where it falls short.

insights.title: What your plan says
insights.allClear: Your plan fits your numbers for the next 12 months.
insights.wantsOverLimit: Wants spending is above this plan's wants limit in {months}.
insights.guiltFreeOverLimit: Guilt-free spending is above its limit in {months}.
insights.savingsShortfall: Less than the pay-yourself-first target is set aside in {months}. Savings goals (sinking funds) count toward it.
insights.babyStepsStep1: Step 1: build the starter emergency fund ({months}).
insights.babyStepsStep2: Step 2: pay off debt before saving extra ({months}).
insights.babyStepsStep3: Step 3: build the full emergency fund ({months}).
insights.babyStepsStep4: Step 4 and on: the emergency fund is complete, start investing ({months}).

sinkingFunds.title: Savings goals
sinkingFunds.intro: Set money aside every month for a bill you know is coming, like car insurance or a holiday. Pick the amount and the month it is due, and Stoafi spreads it evenly over the months left and counts it in your plan.
sinkingFunds.name: Name
sinkingFunds.savedHint: What you have already put aside for it.
sinkingFunds.dueRequired: Choose the month it is due.
sinkingFunds.empty: No savings goals yet. Add one above.

guardSettings.installmentCapHint: When your monthly installments add up to more than this share of your income, Stoafi warns you and asks you to confirm before you commit.
